meta.project: Unified Weights and Measures Verification & Digital Certification Platform

product_overview: A backend platform for registering weighing/measuring instruments, managing statutory applications, executing verification sessions, and issuing digitally signed certificates with public QR-based verification. It supports tenant-scoped workflows for authorities and applicants, while preserving auditability, physical stamp/seal records, and lifecycle history.
core_goals: Enable tenant-scoped instrument registration and registry lookup
Support the full application lifecycle from draft submission through scrutiny, fee assessment, payment, and scheduling
Manage verification sessions with identity confirmation, observations, statutory disposition, and physical stamp/seal tracking
Issue, retrieve, and manage immutable certificates with authenticated PDF export and public QR verification
Provide health and service status endpoints for operational monitoring

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Public liveness and versioned health endpoints expose service availability and engine metadata without authentication.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with service health and engine metadata -> GET /api/v1/health -> Receive 200 with versioned health payload
GET /api/v1/health with service unavailable -> Receive non-200 error or unhealthy status payload indicating degraded service

features.name: Instrument Registry
features.description: Authenticated instrument catalog and per-tenant registry management for approved models, listing, retrieval, and new instrument registration.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/instruments/models with valid tenant and auth headers -> Receive 200 with approved model catalog -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/instruments with model_id and serial_number -> Receive 201 with created instrument record -> GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/instruments/:id -> Receive 200 with instrument details

POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/instruments with missing model_id or serial_number -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/instruments/:id for unknown id -> Receive 404 detail error

GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/instruments as OWNER role -> Receive 200 with owner-filtered paginated instruments -> GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/instruments as unauthorized or cross-tenant caller -> Receive authorization error

features.name: Application Workflow
features.description: Statutory application lifecycle covering draft creation, submission, scrutiny, correction, fee assessment, payment reconciliation, and scheduling.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications with instrument_id and optional declaration fields -> Receive 201 draft application -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications/:id/submit -> Receive 200 submitted application -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications/:id/scrutiny with action ACCEPT -> Receive 200 accepted application -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications/:id/fee with fee amounts -> Receive 200 fee-assessed application -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications/:id/pay with receipt_number -> Receive 200 payment-reconciled application -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications/:id/schedule with ISO slot_start and slot_end -> Receive 200 scheduled application

POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications with invalid instrument_id -> Receive validation error -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications/:id/submit for incomplete draft -> Receive state transition or validation error

POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications/:id/scrutiny with role not permitted -> Receive 403 Role not permitted -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/applications/:id/correction with correction_notes after query -> Receive 200 corrected application

features.name: Verification Sessions
features.description: Field verification session lifecycle including creation, identity confirmation, test start, observations submission, and statutory disposition.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions with application_id and instrument_id as LMO or GATC_VERIFIER -> Receive 201 session -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:id/identity with serial_verified=true -> Receive 200 identity-confirmed session -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:id/start -> Receive 200 started session -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:id/observations with reference_standard_ids and observations -> Receive 200 session with evaluation outcome -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:id/disposition with outcome PASSED_PENDING_AUTHORIZATION -> Receive 200 disposition recorded session

POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions with unauthorized role -> Receive 403 Role not permitted -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:id/observations with invalid or incompatible reference_standard_ids -> Receive 422 fail-closed validation error
GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions -> Receive 200 paginated sessions list -> GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:id -> Receive 200 single session details

features.name: Physical Stamps & Seals Ledger
features.description: Session-attached ledger of physical stamp and seal actions, separated from digital certificate issuance.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:sessionId/stamps with seal_identification_number and seal_position -> Receive 201 stamp/seal record -> GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:sessionId/stamps -> Receive 200 with stamp records for the session

POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:sessionId/stamps with missing seal_identification_number or seal_position -> Receive validation error -> GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/sessions/:sessionId/stamps for unknown session -> Receive authorization or not-found error

features.name: Certificate Lifecycle
features.description: Issue immutable certificates from eligible sessions, manage statutory status changes, and provide authenticated PDF downloads.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/certificates/issue with eligible session_id -> Receive 201 issued certificate with QR and signature metadata -> GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/certificates/:id -> Receive 200 certificate details -> GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/certificates/:id/pdf -> Receive 200 PDF bytes

POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/certificates/issue with ineligible session_id -> Receive 422 Ineligible session -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/certificates/issue with role not permitted -> Receive 403 Role not permitted

GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/certificates -> Receive 200 paginated certificates -> POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/certificates/:id/status with action SUSPEND and reason -> Receive 200 updated certificate status -> GET /certificates/:id/pdf without tenant header -> Receive 200 PDF bytes via tenant-agnostic alias

features.name: Public QR Verification
features.description: Unauthenticated public verification of certificate status and public PDF download using opaque QR references and short alias routes.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/public/certificates/verify/:qrReference -> Receive 200 public certificate status -> GET /api/v1/public/certificates/:qrReference/pdf -> Receive 200 public PDF bytes
GET /api/v1/verify/qr/:qrReference or GET /api/v1/v/:qrReference or GET /v/:qrReference -> Receive 200 public certificate status via alias
GET /api/v1/public/certificates/verify/:qrReference for unknown reference -> Receive 404 Unknown reference
GET /api/v1/public/certificates/:qrReference/pdf for invalid or unknown reference -> Receive 404 or equivalent not-found response

endpoints.description: Service health status with engine metadata
Versioned health endpoint

features.name: Instrument Registry
features.description: Register weighing/measuring instruments, list approved models, list and fetch instruments per tenant

endpoints.description: List approved instrument models catalog
Paginated instrument listing; OWNER role auto-filters to own instruments
Fetch single instrument by id
Register new instrument (requires model_id, serial_number)

features.name: Application Workflow
features.description: Statutory application lifecycle — create, submit, scrutiny (ACCEPT/QUERY/REJECT), correction, fee assessment, payment reconciliation, scheduling

endpoints.description: Paginated applications listing with applicant_id filter
Fetch single application
Create draft application for an instrument
Submit application (state machine transition Draft -> Submitted)
LMO/SUPERVISOR scrutiny decision ACCEPT|QUERY|REJECT
Applicant submits correction notes in response to query
Assess itemized fees (base_verification_fee, user_charge, late_fee, policy_version)
Reconcile payment with receipt_number or payment_gateway_ref
Schedule verification slot with assigned LMO/GATC

features.name: Verification Sessions
features.description: Field verification session lifecycle — create, identity confirmation, start, observations submission with reference standards, statutory disposition verdict

endpoints.description: Paginated session listing
Fetch single session
Create session from scheduled application (LMO/GATC_VERIFIER only)
Confirm instrument identity (serial match)
Start verification testing
Submit test observations with reference_standard_ids; validates standards calibration/range; deterministic MPE error evaluation
Record verifier disposition outcome (PASSED_PENDING_AUTHORIZATION | FAILED | NEEDS_REVIEW etc.)

features.name: Physical Stamps & Seals Ledger
features.description: Decoupled physical stamping and lead-wire seal records attached to sessions

endpoints.description: List stamp/seal records for a session
Record physical stamp/seal action (requires seal_identification_number, seal_position)

features.name: Certificate Lifecycle
features.description: Certificate issuance from eligible finalized sessions, status transitions (SUSPEND/REINSTATE/REVOKE/SUPERSEDE/EXPIRE), authenticated PDF export

endpoints.description: Paginated certificate listing; OWNER auto-filtered
Fetch single certificate
Issue certificate from passed session with Ed25519 signing, RFC8785 hash, opaque QR token (LMO/SUPERVISOR+ roles only)
Statutory status change SUSPEND|REINSTATE|REVOKE|SUPERSEDE|EXPIRE with reason
Authenticated PDF certificate download
Tenant-agnostic PDF alias defaulting to demo tenant

features.name: Public QR Verification
features.description: Zero-PII public certificate status lookup by opaque QR reference plus public PDF download; multiple alias routes

endpoints.description: Primary public verification of certificate status (no auth)
Scanner URL alias for public verification
Short public verification alias (also registered at root /v/:qrReference)
Root-level short public verification alias
Public PDF download by QR reference

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is header-based demonstration mode (X-Actor-Role/X-Tenant-Id headers) with no real token/JWT verification
known_limitations.impact: Any client can impersonate any role including ADMIN in this dev build

known_limitations.issue: Payment reconciliation trusts client-supplied receipt/gateway references without gateway callback signature verification
known_limitations.impact: Payment success cannot be proven server-side in this build

known_limitations.issue: Tenant-scoped PDF alias /certificates/:id/pdf defaults cross-tenant to tenant-delhi-central when no header supplied
known_limitations.impact: Potential tenant isolation weakness on the alias route

known_limitations.issue: Rate limit set to 2000 requests/minute which is high for a public endpoint
known_limitations.impact: Weaker protection against enumeration/scraping of public verify routes
